title: Fennic Railway Brakes files for insolvency protection (simulated)
text: SIMULATED DOCUMENT. All names, events and figures are invented for the demo. Fennic Railway Brakes files for insolvency protection. Fennic Railway Brakes GmbH, a German supplier of rail brake pads and composite brake blocks, filed for protective shield insolvency proceedings at the district court of Neustadt-Rhein on 15 September 2026. The company said that payment obligations of about EUR 38 million could no longer be met after two large customers delayed orders. Management stated that production at the main plant continues and that a restructuring plan will be presented within three months. Fennic employs about 640 people. A spokesperson for one regional operator said it is reviewing its brake pad supply contracts with the company.
